description: The unmodeled-surface case run cloud-connected: a new GET /admin/export endpoint bulk-exports user rows as CSV without the session middleware, and no threat models it. The org library sent with the request has one entry that describes exactly that — T-DATA-004, unauthenticated bulk data export — beside entries that do not fit, so the finding must carry that reference id in library_refs and nothing else. Alignment and policy come from the fixture under cloud/, never from a live call.
